allowed_claims: On the 200-case WixQA simulated configuration-selection cohort, every registered MiniLM Cross-Encoder reranking arm reduced Recall@5 and nDCG@5 versus the dense baseline.
Dense candidate recall increased from 61.42% at Top-5 to 72.00% at Top-10 and 84.58% at Top-20, showing candidate-pool headroom but not reranker quality gain.
The failed validation gate prevented rerunning the historically consumed ExpertWritten cohort.
forbidden_claims: The reranker improved the fixed public ExpertWritten result.
The reranker was promoted to the default retrieval path.
The experiment measured answer correctness or citation quality.
The two-case stronger-model smoke establishes population-level quality.
source_claim_boundary: Configuration selection on the 200-case WixQA simulated cohort; not a blind holdout.
Article retrieval and ranking only; answer and citation quality were not evaluated.
Every registered Cross-Encoder arm failed the frozen validation gate.
The historically consumed ExpertWritten cohort was not rerun because the validation gate failed.
Private questions, article text, case IDs, and per-case outcomes are excluded.
